notes: Perfect claim overlap (C8, C10, C36, C90, C92, C94, C103, C135, C136). Both agree that Srs2p acts as an anti-hybrid factor by antagonizing Rad51p, with deletion causing Rad51p-dependent hybrid formation and YAC instability.
Perfect claim overlap (C69, C70, C126). Both agree that rnh1Δrnh201Δ mutant shows Rad51p-independent hybrid formation, establishing mechanistic heterogeneity in hybrid formation pathways.

High claim overlap (C85, C86, C102). Both accept Rad52p's role in hybrid formation alongside Rad51p, consistent with its known function in loading Rad51p. Peer review presents this without specific critique.

High claim overlap (C47-C54, C100) on YAC-GALpr model validation. LLM finds DIP and functional data sufficient; peer reviewers request additional controls (direct S9.6 DIP/ChIP over ncRNA positions, strand-specific RNA analysis) before accepting the model as fully validated.

Strong claim overlap (C2, C35, C42, C45, C98, C99) on RNA biogenesis mutants. Both acknowledge rad51Δ suppresses hybrids and instability, but peer reviewers express major concern about distinguishing Rad51p's role in hybrid promotion vs. recombination repair, requesting acknowledgment of this uncertainty.

Moderate claim overlap (C60-C65) on Rad51p binding prior to DNA damage. Both express uncertainty: LLM notes absence of γ-H2AX doesn't definitively exclude all damage; peer reviewers maintain overarching concern about distinguishing direct hybrid promotion from damage-recruitment models.

Moderate claim overlap (C6, C38, C73-C76, C118, C119) on trans hybrid formation. LLM finds DIP, instability, and structural analysis compelling; peer reviewers find mechanism 'important' but emphasize need for direct S9.6 DIP/ChIP detection and homology requirement controls before full acceptance.

Partial claim overlap (C5, C56, C104) on Rad51p localization and direct role. Both express uncertainty about whether Rad51p directly promotes hybrids or is recruited to damage sites. LLM wants additional time-course/markers; peer reviewers identify this as 'the major issue' requiring tightening.

Claims C95, C96, C97 on disproportionate Srs2p role at rDNA (23-fold vs 4-fold instability) appear only in LLM results. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for this specific rDNA enrichment finding.

Claims C91, C93 on Rad54/Rdh54 negative controls appear only in LLM results. No corresponding peer review evaluation, though this supports specificity of Srs2p pathway findings that reviewers did accept.

Claims C39, C40, C41 on S9.6 antibody specificity controls appear only in peer review. Reviewers request explicit demonstration of RNase H sensitivity, transcription dependence, and statistical analysis in current study despite prior validation.

Minimal overlap (C37 in LLM only; C4, C5, C56, C104, C105 with partial match). LLM evaluates YAC-GALpr model broadly; peer review focuses specifically on whether Rad51p directly promotes R-loops vs. being recruited to damage, finding evidence insufficient for direct role claim.
